text_block_list.text:
Oh, I was watching one of my mother's
plays on a
streaming site last night.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I don't even remember how many times I
watched
it, but by the time I realized, it
was already
morning.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: You must really love your mother's plays.

text_block_list.text: I do. Watching a play through the screen is nothing like experiencing the acoustics and intensity in person, but it's still... Yawn.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I'll have to be mindful not to pull
any more
all-nighters. I'll try to wake
myself up in time for
training.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
